note: Edited by hand or by the schedule agent. Only Starbase (Texas) launches matter for the trip; Florida flights are listed for context.

lastFlight.name: Flight 14
lastFlight.summary: Ship reached orbit for the first time and deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites. The booster made a controlled splashdown in the Gulf.

upcoming.name: Flight 15
upcoming.headline: The first date from a SpaceX executive: the VP of launch named Friday the 13th on stage at UP.Summit, and the FAA planning slides now say the same. Still no official mission page, launch time, or FAA license for catching both stages on the tower. Booster 22 and Ship 42 have finished their engine tests and the ship catch would be a first.

upcoming.name: Flight 16 · Starlink 30-1
upcoming.headline: An FAA planning date, not a SpaceX announcement. The Florida vehicles may not be ready until mid-January.

upcoming.name: Next Starbase flight
upcoming.headline: Our own estimate: Texas flights have come about nine weeks apart, counted from a mid-November Flight 15. Nothing official.
